description: The algorithm that maps an import specifier to a file. Must match the runtime or bundler.
Node's ESM/CommonJS rules: extensions required in ESM, `type` field and `.mts`/`.cts` decide the format.
Resolution for bundled apps: extensionless and index imports allowed, `exports` still respected.
`package.json` map of public entry points and conditions such as `types`, `import`, `require`, `default`.
Package-private specifiers starting with `#` defined in the `imports` field. Understood by Node, bundlers and TypeScript.
Compile-time aliases. The runtime needs an equivalent alias, since tsc does not rewrite specifiers.
